items.title: Uniswap Universal Router / Permit2 on 46630
items.note: Uniswap lists Robinhood 4663 only; no 46630 deployment. Code exists at the 4663 UR address on 46630 (24546b) but its hash differs from mainnet (0x2ce6aaaf9f4151f5e1cbf774668772f17f532ae11b15e9284fd0a072a8b0fbde) and it has no official listing → unused (fail closed). Permit2 present on 46630 (9152b, hash 0x0117e0ed818bc3f2a8729ffc336c837e63e965f04b473047b39b35ad86aac259); harmless alone but no router to pair with.

items.title: Uniswap Trading API serves 46630
items.note: 46630 → 400 RequestValidationError: "tokenInChainId" must be one of [MAINNET, OPTIMISM, BNB, UNICHAIN, POLYGON, MONA. 4663 → 401 Unauthorized: Unauthenticated api key or session (mainnet needs an API key; read-only quotes allowed once UNISWAP_API_KEY is set).

items.title: Session-key policy enforcement
items.note: Quiver's policy MODEL passes all negative tests locally (transfer/approve/non-allowlisted/recipient≠self/over-cap/daily/expiry/revoke/replay). Alchemy session-key enforcement on 46630 NOT tested (needs Alchemy key + funded testnet account). EntryPoint v0.7 present on 46630.

items.title: Hyperliquid agent wallet cannot withdraw
items.note: Docs: API (agent) wallets 'are only used to sign' on behalf of the master. Docs page does not explicitly state withdraw is rejected; HL testnet withdraw attempt needs a funded master account → not run.

items.title: Pool depth per Stock Token
items.note: No testnet pools/tokens. Mainnet depth requires Uniswap API key (read-only quotes); deferred.

items.title: Third-party terms review (read-only; restrictions noted, no legal conclusions)
items.method: Read public terms/docs pages 2026-10-27 (WebSearch/WebFetch). Full list with URLs in VERIFICATION.md §V11.
items.note: Recorded restrictions for Robinhood Stock Tokens, Chainlink, Uniswap API, 0x API, Hyperliquid, Tiingo. Polymarket ToS text could not be read (US geo interstitial) -> Polymarket signal stays mock-only. Tiingo: free/Individual plans are internal-use only; redistribution needs permission -> modeled EOD stays off by default. Not a legal review; user sign-off required (SIGNOFF.md).

items.title: Testnet ETH faucet
items.note: Faucet page reachable (HTTP 200) but is a client-rendered wallet-connect flow (no documented HTTP API); a scripted claim was not possible and a browser claim was not attempted. Captcha/eligibility rules unconfirmed. No testnet funds obtained; nothing was sent. Not needed for M2: execution is exercised on local anvil.
